description: On the countertop there are four colorful plastic cups (blue, yellow, red, green), a yellow squeeze bottle, and a blue textured sponge pad. The left hand holds and tilts the red cup while the right hand brings the yellow bottle over to the cup’s opening as if dispensing cleaner, then sets the bottle down and picks up the blue sponge pad to press it into the red cup and scrub inside with small pushing and twisting motions, finally pulling the sponge back out.
